subject: Logic
title: The Fallacy Fallacy
description: A quick, practical guide to The Fallacy Fallacy.

hook.text: Someone uses a terrible argument for climate change. Does that prove climate change is false?

buildup.text: The fallacy fallacy assumes a conclusion is wrong just because the argument for it contains a fallacy.

discovery.text: Bad arguments can support true conclusions. Gravity is real even if someone argues for it poorly.

twist.text: Spotting a fallacy only kills the argument—not necessarily the claim it was trying to support.

climax.text: Dismiss the argument, then ask: is there better evidence for or against this conclusion?

punchline.text: Bad proof doesn't mean wrong answer.

quiz.question: What does the fallacy fallacy assume?
options: A flawed argument means a false conclusion
